name: Reckon MCP Server
description: MCP server for reliable email verification in AI-powered workflows. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP client to Reckon's email verification API. Requires a Reckon account and subscription with a positive credit balance.
author: Reckon

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Verify an email address. Returns deliverability status, format validity, domain info, and risk flags (disposable, role-based, accept-all, mailbox full, plus addressing). Each call consumes one credit.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check the remaining email verification credit balance for the connected Reckon account.
